events.verdict: Reid (MIN) braces for contact while moving alongside Smith Jr. (HOU) during his drive to the basket, and the contact is marginal.
McDaniels (MIN) is already in Thompson's (HOU) path and absorbs the contact during the pick.
McDaniels (MIN) and Sengun (HOU) come together off-ball when marginal body contact occurs.
Reid (MIN) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
McDaniels (MIN) retreats in Sengun's (HOU) path with a bent forearm when marginal contact occurs as Sengun spins away during his shot attempt.
Reid (MIN) and Brooks (HOU) engage and separate as Brooks retrieves the loose ball.
Sengun (HOU) establishes himself in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path and absorbs the contact during the pick.
McDaniels (MIN) moves alongside Green (HOU) during his drive to the basket and absorbs the contact as he jumps toward the basket to contest the shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) establishes himself and maintains a legal guarding position in Reid's (MIN) path when he absorbs the body contact during the driving shot attempt.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Sengun (HOU) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Reid (MIN) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds and Houston is correctly given the possession.
Smith Jr. (HOU) extends his arm into Clark (MIN) to create space during the inbound pass, affecting Clark's ability to defend.
Thompson (HOU) moves alongside Reid's (MIN) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Edwards (MIN) commits a take foul on Green (HOU).
After the first free throw, a delay of game warning was assessed to HOU.
Eason (HOU) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds and Minnesota correctly retains the possession.
Smith Jr. (HOU) initiates contact with Conley's (MIN) arm after the release, which affects his follow-through on the jump shot attempt.
Brooks (HOU) establishes himself firming up against Clark's (MIN) side and marginal body contact occurs during the screen.
McDaniels (MIN) commits a take foul on Thompson (HOU).
Holiday (HOU) briefly places his hand around Reid's (MIN) body before correcting.
Reid (HOU) establishes himself in Holiday's (HOU) path and absorbs the contact as the two come together during the screen.
Holiday (HOU) contests Reid's (MIN) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
